sentences.text: Jerry Lewis -LRB- born Joseph Levitch ; March 16 , 1926 -RRB- is an American actor , comedian , singer , film producer , film director , screenwriter and humanitarian .	actor	actor	comedian	comedian	singer	singer	film producer	film producer	film director	film director	screenwriter	screenwriter	humanitarian	humanitarian
He is known for his slapstick humor in film , television , stage and radio .	slapstick	slapstick
He and Dean Martin were partners as the hit popular comedy duo of Martin and Lewis .	Dean Martin	Dean Martin	Martin and Lewis	Martin and Lewis
Following that success , he was a solo star in motion pictures , nightclubs , television shows , concerts , album recordings and musicals .

Lewis served as national chairman of the Muscular Dystrophy Association and hosted the live Labor Day broadcast of the Jerry Lewis MDA Telethon for 44 years .	Muscular Dystrophy Association	Muscular Dystrophy Association	Labor Day	Labor Day	Jerry Lewis MDA Telethon	The Jerry Lewis MDA Labor Day Telethon

Lewis has received several awards for lifetime achievements from the American Comedy Awards , Los Angeles Film Critics Association , Venice Film Festival , Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences and been honored with two stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame .
